name: neverenough-info
description: Personal site for Russell Sherman — neverenough.info

scripts.//build:resume-pdf: Prints /resume/ to dist/resume.pdf with headless Chromium. Part of `build`, not a separate step, so the PDF can never be older than the Markdown it comes from. Needs `npx playwright install chromium` once.
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run verify
